sources: Hypernova Auto (4-star Arts Unit). Skill 3 sk_wpn_funnel_0001 ("When the wielder's HP is above {hp_ratio_c:0%}, ATK +{atk_up:0.0%}."): toggleBuffs buff_wpn_funnel_0001 (attribute 2 formulaItem 6 = ATK %, atk_up) while CheckCurHpRatio (compareType 3) ≥ hp_ratio_c. SkillPatchTable sk_wpn_funnel_0001: atk_up 0.15 (L1) to 0.42 (L9), hp_ratio_c 0.8.

Interim: HP isn't modelled (enemy attacks are events without damage; N1, deferred), so the wielder is at full HP and the buff is on from the start of the fight. Its other effects (Intellect +, Arts DMG +: cardAttributeModifier) are in the stat panel. Docs: docs/kit-batches/batch-2/chr_0023_antal.md.

buffs.label: Hypernova Auto: ATK up (HP above 80%)
buffs.note: No duration: on while the wielder's HP is above hp_ratio_c, i.e. always until HP is modelled.
